Class WebSocketMethods<T>

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.websocket.context.WebSocketMethods<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The bean type
@Internal public final class WebSocketMethods<T> extends Object
The handler methods of a WebSocket bean, classified by their annotations: the methods the WebSocketBeanRegistry calls, and the route of a @ServerWebSocket is built from. An OnMessage method that takes a WebSocketPongMessage handles the pongs, and not the messages. Of several methods of a kind, the last one is the handler.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov
